indispensable_statements.evidence: Equations 7-18 and 21-23 fix the centre frame/Jacobian, n=7 k=0 stress and strain spaces, j0/j factor, centroid offsets, mixed blocks, and positive unshifted 2x2 integration
Equations 19-21 fix the four midside transverse-shear samples, natural interpolation, and pointwise inverse-J transformation
Equation 26.42 expressly deletes the faulty equal-order term by the linear expansion of the drill constraint at the element centre
Equations 26.43-26.45 fix epsilon_hg=1e-3 and the geometry-dependent gamma row
Equations 26.46-26.47 fix the centre-basis transformation and element-local span{1,r,s}
Equations 18-19 print the shell-scalar h-weighted perturbed-Lagrange functional and its eliminated form

The physical scalar multiplier is represented in the common orthonormal frame; the constant determinant of the centre antisymmetric-tensor transform is absorbed bijectively into the three element-local coefficients, leaving no geometry-dependent free scale
Exact differentiation of the physical rational curl at r=s=0 gives C=[c(0),c_r(0),c_s(0)]; B=sum(t*j*P^T*C) and M=sum(t*j*P^T*P), hence B=M*C
Exact Q(sqrt(3)) assembly reproduces the accepted affine E4-0 matrices and closes both non-affine probes without a fitted coefficient
For L=A*p+R*d and positive W, exact R invertibility gives Kdd=R^T*W*R positive definite and the drill Schur complement equal to K5

Under the preregistered fixed-common-frame action, exact K5/K24 D4 counts are 8/8,4/8,4/8,8/8 for square, affine-skew, trapezoid, and tapered-skew; separate reversal fails on affine-skew and trapezoid. Frame embedding, origin, units, patches, supports, and recovery separation pass but cannot override the fatal numbering-covariance failure.
